latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Clip Maker — Create and Export Short Clips.

- Turn raw video footage into trimmed video clips via cloud GPU processing.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4 in 30–60 seconds.
- Automatic session setup with anonymous tokens for new users.
- Handles upload, edit, export, credit checking, and state retrieval via Nemovideo API.
- Streamlined workflows for content creators: quick edits, batch processing, iterative refinement.
